Solar data: reading NOAA SWPC…
Only what is above the horizon sounds. Positions are computed from the clock, your location and low-precision orbital elements (about 1°). Showers sound only inside their real annual windows. Sound after Coil: drones in just intonation with slow beating (Time Machines), a chord that turns with each solstice and equinox (Moon’s Milk), a black-sun gong by day giving way to lunar hush by night (Musick to Play in the Dark), and geomagnetic storms as sparking power lines (Constant Shallowness Leads to Evil). Night adds church organ, bowed viola, marimba, a slow ritual drum and whispered vowels, through tape saturation, hiss and dub delay.
